ordered_diagnoses: Injectable drug-induced skin and muscle injury

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of woody induration of skin and severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa are consistent with scleroderma.

candidates.name: Panniculitis
support_spans: Shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes
candidates.why: The histopathology results showing lobular panniculitis support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Injectable drug-induced skin and muscle injury
support_spans: Patient admitted to self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years, at different sites, including the deltoid areas and abdomen
Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base
candidates.why: The patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections and the presence of cutaneous ulcers and muscle exposure are consistent with injectable drug-induced skin and muscle injury.

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of woody induration and bilateral contracture are consistent with scleroderma.

candidates.name: Panniculitis
support_spans: Shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes

candidates.name: Necrotizing Fasciitis
support_spans: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa
candidates.why: The patient's skin induration and fibrosis are consistent with scleroderma, but the lack of joint inflammation and normal antinuclear antibody levels are not typical for this disease.

candidates.name: Pancreatic Panniculitis
support_spans: lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes
candidates.why: The histopathology findings of lobular panniculitis and necrotic adipocytes are consistent with pancreatic panniculitis.

candidates.name: Injectable Drug-Induced Sclerosing Lipogranuloma
support_spans: Patient admitted to self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm present
candidates.why: The patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections and the presence of foreign-body giant cells are consistent with injectable drug-induced sclerosing lipogranuloma.

selector.rationale: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine and presence of foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm support the diagnosis of Injectable Drug-Induced Sclerosing Lipogranuloma

rejected.label: Scleroderma
rejected.why: Normal antinuclear antibody and lack of joint inflammation contradict the diagnosis

rejected.label: Necrotizing Fasciitis
rejected.why: No evidence of thrombosis or vasculitis and absence of polarizable foreign material do not support the diagnosis

rejected.label: Injectable drug-induced skin and muscle injury
rejected.why: While the patient's history of injections supports this diagnosis, the presence of foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm is more specific to Injectable Drug-Induced Sclerosing Lipogranuloma
